questions.question: The principle of overload means that exercise training should a). Be enjoyable at all times b). Gradually increase the training demand c). Focus only on flexibility d). Avoid fatigue

questions.question: Define afterload?
questions.solution_html:
• • Afterload is the pressure or resistance the ventricles must overcome to
  • eject blood during systole.
  • • It is mainly determined by arterial blood pressure and vascular resistance.

questions.question: Explain the importance of ventricular diastole in the cardiac cycle.
questions.solution_html:
• • Ventricular diastole is the relaxation phase of the ventricles.
  • • It allows ventricular filling with blood from the atria.
  • • Adequate filling ensures an optimal stroke volume during the next
  • contraction.

questions.question: Explain how electrical impulses are generated and conducted through the heart to produce coordinated cardiac contraction.
questions.solution_html:
• heart.
  • • Electrical impulses originate in the Sinoatrial (SA) Node, the heart's
  • natural pacemaker.
  • • The impulse spreads through both atria causing atrial contraction.
  • • It reaches the Atrioventricular (A V) Node, where a brief delay occurs.
  • • The impulse then travels through the Bundle of His.
  • • It continues through the right and left bundle branches.
  • • Finally, Purkinje fibers distribute the impulse throughout the ventricles.
  • • This coordinated conduction produces synchronized ventricular
  • contraction.

questions.question: Describe the factors affecting ventricular filling time.
questions.solution_html:
• • Heart Rate: Increased heart rate reduces filling time.
  • • Venous Return: Greater venous return increases ventricular filling.
  • • Atrial Contraction: Enhances ventricular filling.
  • • Ventricular Compliance: More compliant ventricles fill more easily.
  • • Blood V olume: Increased blood volume improves filling.
  • • Duration of Diastole: Longer diastole allows greater filling.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
questions.final_answer: • Duration of Diastole: Longer diastole allows greater filling.
